integrity: Exact identity proved using first-return formal-series algebra; finite enumeration is independent supporting verification, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite Dyck excursions and unscaled step-height area only. Mixed covariance and affine regression, not complete conditional or nonlinear prediction law. Previously developed Narayana and area recursions are inputs; historical novelty not independently certified.
title: Negative peak–area covariance and a square-root regression slope for uniform Dyck excursions
